text.description_html:
RK International CP-46, Clear Acrylic Retro Cabinet Door Knob with Polished Brass Mounts

Vintage beauty with modern flair--that is RK International's Retro Acrylic Cabinet Pull. The mounts have a distinct retro air, the polished brass finish giving it an art-deco feel that speaks of glamour and glitz. On the other hand, the clear acrylic center modernizers the cabinet pull, brining it into contemporary decor. A perfect balance between old and new.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-46 Acrylic Swirl Pull:

  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-7/8"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Acrylic Color: Clear
  • Mount Finish: Polished Brass
  • Material: clear acrylic with brass mounts
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
